articles.title_en: How the Wealth Was Won: Factor Shares as Market Fundamentals
articles.title_cn: 财富是如何赢得的：因子股作为市场基础
articles.abstract_en: Why does the stock market rise and fall? From 1989 to 2017, the real per capita value of corporate equity increased at a 7.2% annual rate. We estimate that 40% of this increase was attributable to a reallocation of rewards to shareholders in a decelerating economy, primarily at the expense of labor compensation. Economic growth accounted for just 25% of the increase, followed by a lower risk price (21%) and lower interest rates (14%). The period 1952–88 experienced only one-third as much growth in market equity, but economic growth accounted for more than 100% of it.
articles.abstract_cn: 股市为什么会上涨和下跌？从1989到2017，企业股权实际人均价值以7.2%的年增长率增长。我们估计，这种增长的40%归因于在经济减速的情况下对股东的奖励重新分配，主要是以牺牲劳动报酬为代价。经济增长仅占增长的25%，其次是较低的风险价格（21%）和较低的利率（14%）。 1952-88期间，市场权益只经历了一-第三那么多的增长，但经济增长所占的比例却超过了100%。

articles.title_en: Dynamic Gains from Trade Agreements with Intellectual Property Provisions
articles.title_cn: 具有知识产权条款的贸易协定带来的动态收益
articles.abstract_en: I develop a quantitative theory of bilateral trade agreements with intellectual property (IP) provisions in a multicountry growth model. The model’s dynamics are driven by innovation and technology licensing. Imperfect IP enforcement leads to reduced royalty payments and growth. Governments negotiate tariffs and IP enforcement through Nash bargaining. Gains from the trade agreement vary along the transition. Developing countries experience short-term losses, while developed countries gain in both the short and long runs. A government with short-term goals may reduce losses but at the cost of lower growth and welfare. Tariffs could discourage developing countries from deviating from the agreement.
articles.abstract_cn: 我在多国增长模型中开发了带有知识产权 (IP) 条款的双边贸易协定的定量理论。该模型的动力由创新和技术许可驱动。不完善的知识产权执法会导致特许权使用费减少和增长。政府通过纳什讨价还价来谈判关税和知识产权执法。贸易协定带来的收益在转型过程中各不相同。发展中国家遭受短期损失，而发达国家则短期和长期受益。具有短期目标的政府可能会减少损失，但代价是增长和福利下降。关税可能会阻止发展中国家背离协议。

articles.title_en: Labor Market Returns to Personality: A Job Search Approach to Understanding Gender Gaps
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场回归个性：了解性别差距的求职方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of the Big Five personality traits on labor market outcomes and gender wage gaps using a job search and bargaining model with parameters that vary at the individual level. The analysis, based on German panel data, reveals that both cognitive and noncognitive traits significantly influence wages and employment outcomes. Higher conscientiousness and emotional stability and lower agreeableness levels enhance earnings and job stability for both genders. Differences in the distributions of personality characteristics between men and women account for as much of the gender wage gap as do the large differences in labor market experience.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文使用参数因个人水平而异的求职和讨价还价模型，研究了大五人格特征对劳动力市场结果和性别工资差距的影响。这项基于德国面板数据的分析表明，认知和非认知特征都会显着影响工资和就业结果。较高的责任心和情绪稳定性以及较低的宜人性水平可以提高男女的收入和工作稳定性。男性和女性之间性格特征分布的差异与劳动力市场经验的巨大差异一样，是性别工资差距的重要原因。

articles.title_en: Interest Rate Cuts versus Stimulus Payments: An Equivalence Result
articles.title_cn: 降息与刺激支付：等效结果
articles.abstract_en: I derive a general condition on consumer behavior ensuring that, in a standard model of demand-determined output, any path of inflation and output that is implementable via interest rate policy is also implementable through time-varying uniform transfers. In an analytical model with occasionally binding borrowing constraints, my condition holds generically. In a quantitative heterogeneous-agent model, the transfer policy that closes any given demand shortfall is furthermore well characterized by a small number of measurable sufficient statistics. My results extend to environments with investment if transfers are supplemented by another standard fiscal tool: bonus depreciation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我得出了消费者行为的一般条件，确保在需求决定产出的标准模型中，任何可通过利率政策实施的通胀和产出路径也可通过时变统一转移来实施。在偶尔具有约束力的借贷约束的分析模型中，我的条件一般成立。在定量异质代理模型中，弥补任何给定需求缺口的转移政策还可以通过少量可测量的充分统计数据来很好地表征。如果转移辅以另一种标准财政工具：红利折旧，我的结果将延伸到投资环境。

articles.title_en: There’s More to Marriage Than Love: The Effect of Legal Status and Cultural Distance on Intermarriages and Separations
articles.title_cn: 婚姻不仅仅是爱情：法律地位和文化距离对异族通婚和分居的影响
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the contribution of legal status incentives on the marriage choices of natives and migrants. Access to legal status reduces the probability of immigrants intermarrying with natives by 40% and increases the hazard rate of separation for intermarriages by 20%. We develop and estimate a multidimensional equilibrium model of marriage, fertility, and separation, where individuals match on observed and unobserved characteristics. Allowing for trade-offs between cultural distance, legal status, and other socioeconomic spousal characteristics, we quantify the role of legal status and the strength of cultural preferences and evaluate the welfare consequences of granting legal status to immigrants.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了法律地位激励对本地人和移民婚姻选择的贡献。获得合法身份可将移民与当地人通婚的可能性降低40%，并将通婚分居的风险率提高20%。我们开发并估计了婚姻、生育和分居的多维平衡模型，其中个体匹配观察到的和未观察到的特征。考虑到文化距离、法律地位和其他社会经济配偶特征之间的权衡，我们量化了法律地位的作用和文化偏好的强度，并评估了给予移民合法地位的福利后果。

articles.title_en: Persuasion and Matching: Optimal Productive Transport
articles.title_cn: 说服与匹配：最佳生产运输
articles.abstract_en: We consider general Bayesian persuasion problems where the receiver’s utility is single-peaked in a one-dimensional action. We show that a signal that pools at most two states in each realization is always optimal and that such “pairwise” signals are the only solutions under a nonsingularity condition on utilities. Our core results provide conditions under which the induced receiver action is single-dipped or single-peaked on each set of nested signal realizations. We also provide conditions for the optimality of either full disclosure or negative assortative disclosure, where all signal realizations are nested. Methodologically, our results rely on novel duality and complementary slackness theorems. Our analysis extends to a general problem of assigning one-dimensional inputs to productive units, which we call “optimal productive transport.” This problem covers additional applications including matching with peer effects (assigning workers to firms, students to schools, or residents to neighborhoods), robust option pricing (assigning future asset prices to price distributions), and partisan gerrymandering (assigning voters to districts).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一般的贝叶斯说服问题，其中接收者的效用在 一 维动作中是单峰的。我们证明，在每个实现中最多汇集二个状态的信号始终是最优的，并且这种“成对”信号是效用非奇异条件下的唯一解决方案。我们的核心结果提供了在每组嵌套信号实现上感应接收器动作为单谷或单峰的条件。我们还提供了完全披露或负分类披露的最优性条件，其中所有信号实现都是嵌套的。在方法论上，我们的结果依赖于新颖的对偶性和互补松弛定理。我们的分析扩展到将一维投入分配给生产单位的一般问题，我们称之为“最佳生产运输”。这个问题涵盖了其他应用，包括与同伴效应匹配（将工人分配给公司，将学生分配给学校，或将居民分配给社区），稳健的期权定价（将未来资产价格分配给价格分布），以及党派选区划分（将选民分配给地区）。
